title: Mabo v Queensland (No 2) (1992)
summary: Recognised native title at common law, rejecting terra nullius as a blanket doctrine for Australia.
principle: Indigenous land rights and recognition under Australian law.

title: Wik Peoples v Queensland (1996)
summary: Pastoral leases did not necessarily extinguish all native title interests—coexistence models matter.
principle: Native title and pastoral lease coexistence.

title: Lange v Australian Broadcasting Corporation (1997)
summary: Developed implied constitutional freedom of political communication.

title: Plaintiff S157/2002 v Commonwealth (2003)
summary: Constitutional limits on ouster clauses restricting judicial review of migration decisions.
principle: Judicial review and Chapter III courts.

title: Roach v Electoral Commissioner (2007)
summary: Certain blanket disenfranchisement of prisoners was unconstitutional under the franchise implied in the Constitution.

title: Australian Capital Television v Commonwealth (1992)
summary: Struck down a ban on political advertising on TV/radio as infringing implied freedom of political communication.
principle: Implied freedom of political communication in elections.
